summary: CrewMember now records training_observed (True only when @TrainingEndDate is present), training_design_id (0 or empty means None) and training_end, with a training_active property. SnapshotDelta gains crew_training, listing (design, end) changes only for crew whose training was observed in both snapshots. The add_training postcondition is VERIFIED when the member trains the requested design (or starts training whose design is not reported), CONTRADICTED when different training starts or the member disappears, NOT_OBSERVED when training is observed and unchanged, and UNKNOWN when crew or training fields were not observed on both sides. Replaced the always-unknown test with tests for every outcome, and added a delta test. Docs updated.

contract_status_changes.before: add_training always reconciled as UNKNOWN because snapshots did not observe training
contract_status_changes.after: Training state is observed when reported, and add_training has verified, not-observed, contradicted and unknown outcomes

residual_risks: @TrainingDesignId on character records is assumed from field naming in client code; only @TrainingEndDate is read by existing client logic.
A training that starts and finishes between the two snapshots would reconcile as NOT_OBSERVED.
